definitions.explanation: The act of killing insects, especially harmful ones. Most commonly encountered as part of compounds like insecticide or bug spray.

examples.japanese: {殺虫|さっちゅう}{剤|ざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧まいた。
{殺虫|さっちゅう}⟦スプレー→スプレー：11581_supuree⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{蚊|か}→蚊：04294_ka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{退治|たいじ}した→退治する：25396_taijisuru⟧。
examples.english: I killed the mosquitoes with bug spray.

examples.english: In organic farming, chemical insecticides are avoided, and natural enemies are used to control pests.

notes:
A compound of {殺|さつ} (to kill) and {虫|ちゅう} (insect). This word is most commonly encountered in compound forms rather than on its own.

The most frequent usage by far is ⟦{殺虫剤|さっちゅうざい}→殺虫剤：07036_sacchuuzai⟧ (insecticide), which covers everything from household bug sprays to agricultural pesticides. In Japan, insect repellent and insecticide products are especially popular in summer due to mosquitoes and other pests.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {殺虫|さっちゅう}{剤|ざい}: insecticide
- {殺虫|さっちゅう}⟦スプレー→スプレー：11581_supuree⟧: insect spray
- {殺虫|さっちゅう}⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧: insecticidal effect
- {殺虫|さっちゅう}⟦{成分|せいぶん}→成分：04344_seibun⟧: insecticidal ingredient

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{害虫|がいちゅう}→害虫：06430_gaichuu⟧: harmful insect, pest
- ⟦{駆除|くじょ}→駆除：16374_kujo⟧: extermination, pest control — broader term covering any pest removal
- ⟦{防虫|ぼうちゅう}→防虫：17752_bouchuu⟧: insect prevention — focuses on repelling rather than killing
